license_type.description: License type (Subscription, Perpetual, Floating/Shared, Usage-Based, Free/Open-Source, Trial)

bought_from.description: Bought From (e.g., Direct, Reseller, AWS Marketplace)

billing_cycle.description: Billing cycle (Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Annual, Biennial, Custom, None)

attachment_ids.description: IDs of pre-uploaded attachments in attachments table

emp_id.description: Employee ID to assign software to

login_account_id.description: Employee account login / email / license username

cost.description: Total cost for this new term

replaced_by_software_id.description: Replaced by another active software ID

transferred_to_emp_id.description: Transfer license directly to another employee ID

website_quality.description: Set to "No Website" automatically when website is empty

confirm_duplicate.description: Send true after the user confirms the person is not the same as at the other company

contact.description: First contact; becomes the primary contact

confirm_duplicate.description: Send true after the user confirms "This is a different company"

company.description: Only the keys that are sent change

lead_source.description: Lead Source master label. Starts as "Cold calling"; forced to "Existing client" for a client.

lead_by_id.description: Employee id. Defaults to the user who is converting; that user is told when it is someone else.

service_fit.description: One or many Service Fit labels (required). A single string is accepted too.

first_note.description: Saved as a Requirement note on the lead

assigned_to.description: Employee id; defaults to the user who is logging

contact_id.description: person_id of a contact of the company

communication_date.description: Defaults to now; cannot be in the future

outcome.description: Required in the Log Conversation popup

next_follow_up.description: The "Schedule next follow-up" part, saved together with the conversation

is_pinned.description: Keeps the note near the top of the timeline

service_fit.description: Corrects the Service Fit in the Qualify popup

follow_up_on.description: Check-back date; becomes a Pending follow-up

assigned_to.description: Employee id; defaults to the Lead By user

reason.description: Lost reason master label. "Other" needs a note.

lead_by_id.description: Employee id of the new Lead By user

company_id.description: Or a company that is not yet a lead (a company with an open lead uses that lead)

contact_id.description: person_id of a contact of the company; starts as the primary contact

assigned_to.description: Employee id; starts as the Lead By user

action.description: schedule = Schedule next follow-up, qualify = Qualify lead, hold = Put on hold, lost = Mark as lost, none = No next step

follow_up_on.description: schedule / hold: the next follow-up or check-back date

reason.description: hold: why the talks are paused

done_on.description: Starts as now; not before the follow-up was created

what_happened.description: Saved as a conversation on the lead

reason.description: Why it will not be done (required)

contact_id.description: person_id; starts as the lead contact

assigned_to.description: Employee id; starts as the Lead By user

won_on.description: Won on: the date the company said yes (YYYY-MM-DD). Today or a past date, not before the lead was added.

win_note.description: Win note: what was agreed, such as the PO or the scope. Saved on the lead and the client.

mapping.description: File column key -> field key (null = do not import). Starts as the automatic match.

create_leads.description: Also create a lead for rows that have Lead Source, Lead By and Service Fit

existing_rows.description: Rows already in the database: skip them, or fill only their empty fields

ids.description: Selected rows only. Without it, the whole current list (its filters are sent as the query string).

include_next_follow_up.description: Companies only: add the Next Follow-up column
